title_sq: VILE NE SHITJE MBRAPA AMBASADES AMERIKANE, TIRANE!
description_sq:
Ne shitje vile e vendosur mbrapa Ambasades Amerikane.
Vila eshte e organizuar ne 3 kate perkatesisht:
-Kati perdhe me nje siperfaqe prej 78 m2 dhe 8.5 m2 verande, ambienti brendeshem organizuar: sallon ndenje dhe 1 tualet
-Kati i dyte me nje siperfaqe prej 88.1 m2 dhe 45 m2 verande, ambienti i brendshem organizuar: ambient gatimi, dhome gjumi dhe 1 tualet
-Kati i trete me nje siperfaqe 90 m2 dhe 21.7 m2, ambienti i brendshem organizuar: 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 1 tualet
-Papafingo me nje siperfaqe 26.8 me dhe 11 m2 verande
Vendosur prane rruges se Elbasanit, nje mundesi ideale investimi.
Me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion dhe per nje vizite ne prone mund te kontaktoni!
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE BEHIND THE AMERICAN EMBASSY, TIRANA!
description_en: Villa for sale located behind the American Embassy. The villa is organized on 3 floors, respectively: - Ground floor with an area of 78 m2 and 8.5 m2 veranda, organized internal environment: living room and 1 toilet - Second floor with an area of 88.1 m2 and 45 m2 veranda, organized internal environment: kitchen area, bedroom and 1 toilet - Third floor with an area of 90 m2 and 21.7 m2, the internal environment is organized: 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom -Attic with a surface of 26.8 m2 and 11 m2 veranda Located near Elbasan road, an ideal investment opportunity. With regular mortgage documentation. For more information and a visit to the property, you can contact us!
